description:
Korean Spoons Made by 40-Year Master Craftsmen

Hello, this is King Process.
Today, we visited the Myungsung Steel spoon factory.
A spoon is something we use every day without thinking much about it,
but behind it, there is the time and care of people who have kept doing this work for many years.
It may not be a flashy object,
but because it is something we hold and use at the table every day,
even the smallest details matter here.
Korean spoons made by master craftsmen with 40 years of experience.
Hope you enjoy watching.
